motivating_context: User-proposed hypothesis, tested directly rather than debated: every route so far (S13-S39, 41 routes) entered on a 15m signal conditioned on structure, flow, or a forced-deleveraging signature. This protocol tests a mechanically different shape entirely -- fewer, larger trades -- by only entering when price is at a genuine statistical extreme on the 4H timeframe (oversold -> long, overbought -> short), with a wide stop beyond the recent 4H swing and the patient breakeven+chandelier exit that is the only execution style anywhere in this project with any track record (S20 H1). Universe is widened from the usual 3-6 symbols to 8 liquid pairs (BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA, SUI, DOGE), also user-requested, because a genuinely rare per-symbol trigger needs more independent symbols to reach a meaningful sample size -- this widens breadth of opportunity, it does not change the entry logic itself. Pure price/momentum signal: no open interest, funding, or order-block features are used.
pre_freeze_calibration_disclosure: H1's RSI threshold was checked for whether it fires at all (a functional smoke test, not a performance check) before this protocol was frozen: RSI(14) beyond 10/90 on 4H never fired even once on BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT or XRPUSDT across the full development window. It was loosened one standard tier to 20/80 (still stricter than the conventional 30/70) before any PnL was computed on any symbol -- disclosed per this project's audit-amendment convention.

hypotheses.entry_exit: 4H bar closes with RSI(14) <= 20 (long) or >= 80 (short). Stop beyond the trailing 6-bar (24h) 4H swing low/high plus a 0.25x ATR buffer. Exit reuses S20 H1's patient breakeven+chandelier runner: partial at 1.5R, breakeven, chandelier trail at 2.5x (4H) ATR, hard cap at 8R, max hold 3 days.
Identical stop/target/trail as H1, EXCEPT the trigger is a 20-period Bollinger z-score beyond +-2.5 sigma on the 4H close instead of RSI.
hypotheses.note: A price-distance definition of 'extreme', independent of RSI's momentum definition -- the two frozen hypotheses test two standard, unrelated ways of defining the same concept, not a parameter sweep of one.

single_variable_isolated: Both hypotheses share an identical stop/target/trail execution model (S20 H1, unmodified) and an identical universe. H1 and H2 differ only in which standard technical definition of 'extreme' triggers entry -- RSI momentum extreme vs Bollinger price-distance extreme.

symbols.note: Widened from the 3-6 symbol clusters used by every prior scalp route in this project, per user request and because this signal is rare per symbol. Reuses already-cached klines archives -- no funding/OI metrics archive required since the signal is pure price/momentum.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 (of contributing) symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated 8-symbol cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2. No parameter grid beyond the single pre-freeze RSI-threshold correctness fix disclosed above (a firing-rate check, not a performance check). A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: Rare per-symbol signal even at the loosened 20/80 threshold (4-12 raw candidates per symbol over 6 months in the pre-freeze smoke check) -- reaching the 40-fill development minimum depends on the 8-symbol breadth, a legitimate, disclosed possible outcome if it still falls short, not grounds to loosen thresholds further after seeing PnL.

No trend/regime filter: this route deliberately fades whatever the 4H extreme is, including during strong sustained trends where RSI/price can stay extreme for a long time before any reversion -- the classic mean-reversion-into-a-trend risk, left unmitigated on purpose so the raw hypothesis is tested cleanly.

4H ATR-based stop/trail is coarser and the max hold (3 days) far longer than any prior route in this project -- funding costs accrue over a materially longer average hold than the 15m-entry family, which the simulator already models via the loaded funding archive.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result unless it clears every gate through retrospective_evaluation.
